claim: If you need external connections from the internet, AWS recommends Elastic Load Balancing; to connect an application to other applications that run in Amazon ECS services without a load balancer, AWS recommends Service Connect, which provides Amazon ECS configuration for service discovery, connectivity, and traffic monitoring, and lets your applications use short names and standard ports to connect to Amazon ECS services.

evidence.quote: If you need external connections from the internet, we recommend using Elastic Load Balancing.

We recommend Service Connect, which provides Amazon ECS configuration for service discovery, connectivity, and traffic monitoring. With Service Connect, your applications can use short names and standard ports to connect to Amazon ECS services in the same cluster, other clusters, including across VPCs in the same AWS Region.
